name: sentryward
description: Self-hosted AI code reviewer with automated reviews, inline suggestions, and flexible support for cloud and local models.

readme.excerpt:
Self-hosted AI code review for GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests.

Quick start · How it works · Configuration · Changelog · Discussions

Sentryward is an AI code reviewer for GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests. Connect repositories, choose a model provider or Ollama, and run manual or automatic reviews with inline findings, walkthroughs, and commit statuses. The dashboard tracks reviews and findings across runs. > [!WARNING] > Sentryward is pre-1.0: minor releases may include breaking changes. AI findings > need human verification and can miss problems or report false positives. > `docker-compose.yml` is for development; to host an instance, see [Deploying](#deploying). ## Contents - [Highlights](#highlights) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Getting started](#getting-started): [runtime environment](#docker-runtime-environment), [users and invites](#users-and-invites), [workspaces and teams](#workspaces-and-teams), [first review](#run-your-first-review), [troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Deploying](#deploying) - [Forge connections](#forge-connections), [publishing](#publishing-to-the-forge), [automatic reviews](#automatic-reviews), [notifications](#notifications) - [Review configuration](#review-configuration): [LLM connections](#llm-connections-and-custom-endpoints), [Ollama](#ollama), [`.sentryward.yaml`](#sentrywardyaml-reference), [review rules](#review-rules) - [Privacy and data](#privacy-and-data): [what is stored](#what-is-stored), [what leaves the server](#what-leaves-the-server), [retention](#retention), [provider restrictions](#provider-and-host-restrictions), [audit log](#audit-log) - [API](#api) - [Development](#development) - [Contributing and license](#contributing-and-license) ## Highlights - **Self-hosted, bring your own model:** Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, a compatible proxy on a [custom host](#llm-connections-and-custom-endpoints), or a local [Ollama](#ollama) model. - **GitHub and GitLab:** a GitHub App, plus GitLab.com or self-hosted GitLab. - **Reviews where you work:** inline findings with suggestions, one summary comment, and a `sentryward/review` commit status. - **Manual or automatic:** submit a PR/MR URL, review on webhooks, or comment `/sentryward review`. - **Per-repository config:** dashboard settings, overridable by a [`.sentryward.yaml`](#review-configuration) in the repository. - **Findings across runs:** a later run never posts the same finding twice. Ignore findings as false positives, intentional, or fix later, and track the false-positive rate on the dashboard, broken down by category, severity and model with a pointer to the setting that would quiet the noisiest ones. - **Teams:** share connections, repositories, reviews and model keys in team workspaces, with owner, admin and member roles and one-time invite links, managed from **Team settings** in the workspace switcher. ## Quick start ```sh git clone https://github.com/rdlugs/sentryward.git && cd sentryward cp .env.exam
